controls.procedure: Compare final Git blobs with the canonical Prettier output captured by the repository runner.
controls.expected: Only byte-identical canonical formatter output is accepted.
controls.observed: Both final script blobs equal the Git hashes produced from the runner formatter artifact.

controls.procedure: Enforce direct result-only child publication and compare all changed paths against the certificate allowlist.
controls.expected: No material write can coexist with a terminal certificate for an ancestor.
controls.observed: The frozen subject is fixed and terminal reconciliation is configured to reject parent or path drift.

controls.procedure: Exercise the viewport identity contract independently from document content-width and overflow assertions.
controls.expected: Scrollbar/content width cannot redefine the device viewport identity.
controls.observed: The exact-head contract keeps viewport identity separate from content-width measurements and mutation checks.

controls.procedure: Exercise horizontal overflow accounting independently from viewport identity metadata.
controls.expected: Deleting the document-fit assertion must make the coverage control fail.
controls.observed: The exact-head semantic contract retains a separate global-overflow assertion and fail-closed mutation behavior.

controls.procedure: Freeze only after the last material write and reject any certificate whose direct parent is not that material SHA.
controls.expected: Any later material write invalidates ancestor readiness.
controls.observed: Material d4a83c41d3995a0ad01bc46b19677d1013cc795e is the current frozen subject for the forthcoming direct result-only child.

controls.procedure: Recompare the two final files against canonical formatter output after the last material write.
controls.expected: A visual pass cannot substitute for canonical source bytes.
controls.observed: Final blob eac0faf009371cb3b63a119bdd1757d14d1cbeea and d9229c3120f6c2a00b86e41c54531124c7332222 match the runner output artifact.

controls.procedure: Load behavior evidence with the expected candidate and reject a report whose commit field differs.
controls.expected: Ancestor evidence presented as current is rejected.
controls.observed: The exact-head adapter compares report.commit with the candidate subject before emitting behavior assertions.

controls.procedure: Bind raw control evidence to its recorded SHA-256 and reject modified evidence bytes.
controls.expected: Mismatched evidence bytes cannot be accepted from matching narrative metadata.
controls.observed: Current handoff evidence files are content-addressed and their hashes are recomputed for the frozen subject.

controls.procedure: Remove a required component/mobile behavior assertion while preserving components, legacyProcessorIds and desktop-mobile metadata.
controls.expected: Metadata-only coverage is rejected for component, legacy responsibility and desktop/mobile claims.
controls.observed: The exact-head contract requires behavior assertions and exact-subject evidence; the mutation control rejects the metadata-only variant.
